d: The Enterprise Data Platform Specialist is responsible for supporting the technical implementation, integration, administration, optimization, and operational sustainability of the Central Bank of Oman’s enterprise data platforms (including Data Collection Platform, Data Lake, data warehouse, MDM and other related technologies).

The role plays a critical role in establishing a reliable, secure, scalable and integrated data technology ecosystems that enables CBO to efficiently collect, store, process, manage, govern, exchange and analyse data from internal and external sources. It will also contribute to CBO’s digital and data transformation agenda by enabling effective regulatory data collection, supervisory intelligence, financial stability analysis, economic research, data-driven decision making and the development of advanced analytics capabilities.
q: Bachelor’s degree in Computer Science, Software Engineering, Information Systems, Data Science, Data Management, or a closely related discipline.
Master’s degree in Information Management, Information Systems, Data Governance, Data Science, or a related field.
Relevant professional certifications in enterprise data platforms or data management such as CDMP (Certified Data Management Professional).
Minimum of 3-5 years of relevant professional experience in enterprise data platforms, data engineering, data architecture, data integration or related technical disciplines.
Practical experience in platform administration, troubleshooting, integration, performance monitoring and technical documentation.
Experience collaborating with technology vendors, technical delivery teams and business stakeholders.
Experience working in a regulatory or financial services environment.
Experience with regulatory reporting systems and understanding of financial supervisory data.
Participation in digital transformation initiatives and large-scale data modernization projects.
Familiarity with regulatory technologies (RegTech) or supervisory technologies (SupTech).
Please submit your application before 28th Nov 2026.
r: li
Support the day-to-day administration, configuration, monitoring, maintenance and optimization of CBO’s enterprise data platforms.
li
Ensure reliable platform operations through proactive monitoring of availability, utilization, data processing activities and system performance.
li
Support installation, upgrades, patching, configuration changes and technical enhancements in accordance with approved change management procedures.
li
Collaborate with data engineering specialists to ensure robust delivery of data pipelines and data stores to support analytics, regulatory reporting, and operational needs.
li
Collaborate with internal stakeholders to align data architecture with business requirements, regulatory standards, and IT strategies to reflect in the data warehouse/ lake house structures.
li
Manage relationships with external vendors or partners providing data-related tools or services.
li
Provide technical support, troubleshooting and resolve platform-related incidents.
li
Maintain data platform technical documentation and operational procedures.
li
Lead the design and implementation of metadata management initiatives relating to the CBO’s data platforms and downstream workloads.
li
Establish and enforce data architecture standards, best practices, and policies within CBO’s data platforms.
li
Assess current data landscape and identify opportunities to improve data quality, consistency, availability, and security.
li
Work with the DG and DQ teams to ensure the data model is maintained to ensure consistency and improved DQ.
li
Support regulatory compliance by ensuring that the data platforms accommodate legal, ethical, and industry-specific standards.
li
Ensure timely renewal and active subscription related to data platforms licenses and contracts.

d: Canonical is a leading provider of open source software and operating systems to the global enterprise and technology markets. Our platform, Ubuntu, is very widely used in breakthrough enterprise initiatives such as public cloud, data science, AI, engineering innovation and IoT. Our customers include the world's leading public cloud and silicon providers, and industry leaders in many sectors. The company is a pioneer of global distributed collaboration, with 1200+ colleagues in 75+ countries and very few office based roles. Teams meet two to four times yearly in person, in interesting locations around the world, to align on strategy and execution.
The company is founder led, profitable and growing.

We require an HR function that thinks and acts globally. We're looking for a Senior HR Generalist to offer their expertise to our EMEA region. It's an exciting time to join with the opportunity to help shape and create an HR function for the future. The senior role will serve as a driver and practitioner in both regional and global HR initiatives. You will join a global team of HR professionals to provide precise, compliant and scalable HR operations to the business, advise and execute on HR issues across the whole employee life-cycle, and partner with leadership in your region. You will have an analytical approach, a keen eye for detail and the ability to interpret data trends and themes.
Location: This role will be based remotely in the EMEA region
Deliver precise and compliant HR operations in a timely manner and with the highest degree of accuracy
Interact closely with the EMEA HR Manager and the Global Head of HR to create impact across all HR regions
Be accountable for HR processes such as talent development, succession planning, performance assessments, onboarding, culture and engagement initiatives that drive a high performing team
Work with managers across the business on performance management, organizational design, employee engagement, rewards- and workforce planning
Partner with the HRIS team to develop and refine operational processes for day to day HR administration
Coach and advise people managers on the full spectrum of employee relations issues across multiple countries
Partner with people managers to support the delivery of appropriate training and development programs
Establish a trusted partnership with the business in your region
Drive diversity, equity, and inclusion initiatives
Design new policies and deliver on business-critical HR related projects globally
What we are looking for in you
Exceptional academic track record from both high school and university
HR experience leading initiatives across regions within a technology business
Regional HR experience within EMEA (France, Germany and/or UK is a plus), with an understanding of local labor laws, competitive awareness and insights
Experience in business partnering with senior stakeholders
A good balance between leading and executing, in this role you will need to be hands-on involved in the daily HR routines
Strong project management skills with the ability to define done and keep deliverables on track
Experience in working in a remote first organization
Able to leverage data to make informed decisions
Fluent in business English (written and spoken)
Self motivated, organized, accurate, confident, authentic, results-orientated, open-minded and enthusiastic
Willingness to travel up to 4 times a year for internal events
Experience with immigration policies and mobility processes
Knowledge of HR Systems and databases

We consider geographical location, experience, and performance in shaping compensation worldwide. We revisit compensation annually (and more often for graduates and associates) to ensure we recognise outstanding performance. In addition to base pay, we offer a performance-driven annual bonus. We provide all team members with additional benefits, which reflect our values and ideals. We balance our programs to meet local needs and ensure fairness globally.
Distributed work environment with twice-yearly team sprints in person
Personal learning and development budget of USD 2,000 per year
Opportunity to travel to new locations to meet colleagues
Priority Pass, and travel upgrades for long haul company events

Canonical is a pioneering tech firm at the forefront of the global move to open source. As the company that publishes Ubuntu, one of the most important open source projects and the platform for AI, IoT and the cloud, we are changing the world of software. We recruit on a global basis and set a very high standard for people joining the company. We expect excellence - in order to succeed, we need to be the best at what we do. Most colleagues at Canonical have worked from home since its inception in 2004. Working here is a step into the future, and will challenge you to think differently, work smarter, learn new skills, and raise your game.
Canonical is an equal opportunity employer

We are proud to foster a workplace free from discrimination. Diversity of experience, perspectives, and background create a better work environment and better products. Whatever your identity, we will give your application fair consideration.
